propositions: A single exact JSON object reply is decoded twice—once from _all_json_objects and once from json.loads—creating identical semantic candidates that are treated as ambiguous due to identity comparison of separately constructed Pydantic instances.
Native structured replies emit false 'multiple candidates validated' warnings when the first and last candidates are semantically identical, despite equality and serialized values matching.
The parser uses identity (is not) rather than value equality to detect semantic conflict, causing non-identical Pydantic objects with equal data to trigger ambiguity warnings.

Deduplicating semantically identical decoded candidate dicts in discovery order before validation eliminates false warnings while preserving last-valid-wins behavior for genuinely distinct candidates.
